en_title: Nintendo Rules Out Further Switch 2 Price Rises as Console Sales and Profit Fall
cn_title: 主机销量和利润下滑，任天堂排除再次上调Switch 2价格的可能性
opus_summary: 任天堂公布的财报显示，Switch 2本财年上半年销量为649万台，低于去年同期的1036万台；截至9月30日的三个月，营业利润下降16%。社长古川俊太郎表示，任天堂拥有足够内存以达成全年销量预测，目前不考虑进一步调整价格。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo has ruled out further Switch 2 price rises while reporting falling console sales and reduced profit.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂在公布主机销量和利润下滑的同时，排除了再次上调Switch 2价格的可能性。

paragraphs.en: According to Bloomberg , operating profit fell 16% to 73.9 billion ‌yen (approx. $467 million) during the three months to September 30, off the back of a 15% decline in sales. CNBC said Nintendo sold 2.67 million Switch 2 units in the quarter, down 41% from the same period last year and down from the 3.82 million units that were sold during the first quarter of the current financial year (April to June 2026). Nintendo raised the price of Switch 2 in September, fueled by the ongoing ‘RAMpocalypse’ that has also seen Microsoft and Sony raise the price of their consoles.
paragraphs.cn: 据彭博社报道，在截至9月30日的三个月中，销售额下降15%，营业利润随之下降16%，至739亿日元（约合4.67亿美元）。CNBC称，任天堂在该季度售出267万台Switch 2，较去年同期下降41%，也低于本财年第一季度（2026年4月至6月）售出的382万台。任天堂于9月上调了Switch 2的价格，原因是持续发生的「RAMpocalypse」，这也导致微软和索尼上调了旗下主机的价格。

paragraphs.en: Despite this, Reuters reported that Nintendo President Shuntaro Furukawa insisted Nintendo had enough memory to meet its forecasted Switch 2 sales of 16.5 million units for the financial year ending March 2027, and is not considering further price changes.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管如此，路透社报道称，任天堂社长古川俊太郎坚称，任天堂拥有足够的内存，能够满足截至2027年3月的财年中Switch 2预计1650万台的销量，且公司没有考虑进一步调整价格。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo launches the Ocarina of Time remake today, and investors are hoping it will boost sales of the Switch 2 during the holiday sales season. Reuters said that investors remain concerned that the memory situation, as well as a “lack of high-profile titles” for Switch 2 this year, could negatively affect the console's momentum.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂今天推出《Ocarina of Time》重制版，投资者希望它能在假日销售季提振Switch 2的销量。路透社称，投资者仍担心内存形势以及Switch 2今年「缺乏备受瞩目的游戏」可能对这款主机的发展势头产生负面影响。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo's financial report reveals data for the first half of the current financial year, (from April to September 2026). During that six month period, Nintendo sold 6.49 million Switch 2 units, down from the 10.36 million it sold during the same period last year.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂的财报披露了本财年上半年（2026年4月至9月）的数据。在这六个月内，任天堂售出649万台Switch 2，低于去年同期售出的1036万台。

paragraphs.en: But there's important context to note here. Lifetime sales of the Switch 2 are now 26.35 million, which means it’s still outpacing the original Switch in terms of launch aligned sales (the first six quarters after release). It’s also worth noting that the Switch 2 enjoyed a record-breaking launch, fueled by ample stock availability, that saw it become the fastest-selling console of all time , so it was always going to be up against tough comparisons during its second year.
paragraphs.cn: 但这里有重要的背景需要注意。Switch 2的累计销量目前为2635万台，这意味着按上市后的相同时间段（发售后的前六个季度）计算，它的销量仍超过初代Switch。还值得注意的是，Switch 2在充足库存的推动下取得了破纪录的首发成绩，成为有史以来销售速度最快的主机，因此它在第二年总会面临严苛的同比比较。

paragraphs.en: And countering apparent concern from investors, shares in Nintendo jumped 8.13% today following the release of the Ocarina of Time remake and the company's financial report.
paragraphs.cn: 而与投资者表现出的担忧相反，在《Ocarina of Time》重制版发售及公司财报公布后，任天堂股价今天上涨了8.13%。

paragraphs.en: As for video game sales, Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream sold 8.81 million units, Rhythm Heaven Groove sold 2.89 million units, and Splatoon Raiders sold 2.42 million units. Mario Kart World, which launched alongside the Switch 2 last year, “continued to sell steadily,” Nintendo said, shifting a further 1.78 million units during the two quarters.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏销量方面，《朋友收集 梦想生活》售出881万份，《节奏天国 奇迹之星》售出289万份，《斯普拉遁 涂击队》售出242万份。任天堂称，去年与Switch 2一同推出的《马力欧卡丁车世界》「持续稳定销售」，在这两个季度又售出了178万份。

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere, StarFox, released in June, sold 1.17 million units, and Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave, released in September, sold 1.34 million units. The expectation is that Nintendo will have some big hitters for Switch 2 in 2027, including, fans hope, the next mainline Super Mario game. Pokémon Winds & Pokémon Waves are confirmed for next year.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，6月发售的《StarFox》售出117万份，9月发售的《火焰纹章: Fortune’s Weave》售出134万份。人们预计任天堂将在2027年为Switch 2推出一些重磅游戏，粉丝希望其中包括下一款《超级马力欧》系列正传游戏。《宝可梦Winds》和《宝可梦Waves》已确认将于明年推出。

paragraphs.en: “Nintendo’s only real blockbuster this fiscal year is the Ocarina Of Time remake," Serkan Toto, CEO of Kantan Games, told CNBC . "It’s not enough to make investors happy, especially after the device is now as expensive as it is.
paragraphs.cn: Kantan Games首席执行官Serkan Toto告诉CNBC：「任天堂本财年唯一真正的重磅作品是《Ocarina Of Time》重制版。这不足以让投资者满意，尤其是这款设备现在已经这么贵了。

paragraphs.en: “It’s getting harder and harder to sell video game hardware these days, and only hits help. Nintendo must step on the gas and deliver more big games next fiscal year to make sure the Switch 2 momentum continues.”
paragraphs.cn: 「如今游戏硬件越来越难卖，只有热门游戏才有帮助。任天堂必须加快步伐，在下一个财年推出更多大型游戏，以确保Switch 2的发展势头得以延续。」
